policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="responseRef" value="@{
            var id = context.Request.MatchedParameters.GetValueOrDefault("response_id", "");
            if (id == "" && context.Request.Method == "POST") {
                var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
                id = body?["previous_response_id"]?.ToString() ?? "";
            }
            return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(id, "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$") ? id : "";
        }" />
        
        
            
                
                
                    
                        
                    
                    
                        
                            
                            
                                application/json
                            
                            
                                response-ownership
                            
                            
                                @(context.RequestId.ToString())
                            
                            @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                new JProperty("code", "ResponseNotFound"),
                                new JProperty("message", "Response '" + (string)context.Variables["responseRef"] + "' was not found for this subscription.")))).ToString())
                        
                    
                    
                        
                        
                        
                        
                            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", "") == "")">

choose.when:
<set-variable name="newResponseId" value="@{
                    var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var stored = body["store"] == null || body["store"].Type == JTokenType.Null || (bool)body["store"];
                    var id = body["id"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                    return stored && System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(id, "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$") ? id : "";
                }" />
                
                    <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["newResponseId"] != "" && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attemptBackend", "") != "")">
                        <cache-store-value key="@("resp-" + (string)context.Variables["newResponseId"])"
                            value="@((string)context.Variables["attemptBackend"] + "|" + (context.Subscription?.Id ?? "") + "|" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", ""))"
                            duration="2592000" />
